# Explore FIT datasets

## Import required codes
```{r}
# install.packages("here")
library(here)
source(here("scripts_notebooks", "required.R"))
```

## Found in translation
Ref: Normand, R., Du, W., Briller, M. et al. Found In Translation: a machine learning model for mouse-to-human inference. Nat Methods 15, 1067–1073 (2018). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-018-0214-9
Github: https://github.com/shenorrLabTRDF/FIT.mouse2man 

- Standard (ST): which include human and mouse datasets that were conducted in separate experiments;
- Reference (RF), in which the human and mouse datasets were directly contrasted in a publication authored by researchers who had generated at least one of the datasets.
- CSP IDs can be enumarated by different comparisons with different mice strains, for example A/J and CD1 mice, and timpoints (not clearly stated).
```{r}
#Install model package
# library(devtools)
library(FIT.mouse2man)

#Import files
pca_rotations = FIT.mouse2man::pca_rotations
best_models = FIT.mouse2man::best_models
slopes_per_gene_V2.0 = FIT.mouse2man::slopes_per_gene_V2.0

#Gene lookup table
HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez = FIT.mouse2man::HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
  rename(human_symbol = HGNC_symbol,
         mouse_symbol =MGI.symbol,
         HS.Entrez = Human.Entrez,
         MM.Entrez = Mouse.Ortholog) %>% 
  mutate(HS.Entrez = as.character(HS.Entrez),
         MM.Entrez = as.character(MM.Entrez))

#Training data
AllData_V2.0 = FIT.mouse2man::AllData_V2.0 %>% 
  mutate(csp_id_short = str_remove(CSP_ID, "Microarrays_RF_"),
         csp_id_short = str_remove(csp_id_short, "Microarrays_ST_"),
         csp_id_short = str_remove(csp_id_short, "RNAseq_ST_"),
         csp_id_short = str_remove(csp_id_short, "RNAseq_RF_")) %>% 
  inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez, 
             by = join_by("HS.Entrez", "MM.Entrez")) %>% 
  separate(csp_id_short, into = c("del", "csp_id_index")) %>% 
  select(-del)
  
#Check
AllData_V2.0$csp_id_index %>% unique()

```


## Filter datasets
Get metadata for datasets on Supplementary Files of FIT paper and filter datasets with blood-derived samples
```{r}
#Get metadata for datasets on Supplementary Files of FIT paper and filter datasets with blood-derived samples
#Import
fit_training_datasets_metadata <- read_excel(here("tables", "processed_data", "FIT_metadata_supplementary.xlsx"))

#Clean grouped header
fit_training_datasets_metadata_newcols = fit_training_datasets_metadata %>% 
  slice_head(n = 2) %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  
  #Fill sub columns
  rownames_to_column("V0") %>% 
  
  mutate(V1 = if_else(is.na(V1), V0, V1),
         V0 = ifelse(str_detect(V0, "^\\.\\.\\.\\d+$"), NA, V0),
         V1 = ifelse(str_detect(V1, "^\\.\\.\\.\\d+$"), NA, V1)) %>% 
  
  #Fill columns
  fill(V0, .direction = "down") %>% 
  fill(V1, .direction = "down") %>% 
  
  #Fill columns manually
  mutate(V2 = if_else(V0 == V1, V0, V2),
         V3 = if_else(V0 == V1, V0, NA),
         V3 = if_else(is.na(V2), paste0(V0,"_", V1), V2),
         V2 = if_else(is.na(V2), V3, V2),
         V3 = if_else(V2 == "Disease" & V0 != "Disease", 
                      paste0(V0, "_", V1, "_", V2), 
                      V3),
         V3 = if_else(V2 == "Control" & V0 != "Control", 
                      paste0(V0, "_", V1, "_", V2), 
                      V3),
         #Clean table further
         V3 = str_remove(V3, " Data"),
         V3 = make_clean_names(V3)) %>% 
  select(V3)

#Set new names
fit_training_datasets_metadata_clean = fit_training_datasets_metadata %>% 
  filter(!row_number() %in% c(1:2)) %>% 
  setNames(fit_training_datasets_metadata_newcols %>% pull()) %>% 
    clean_names() %>%
  fill(disease, .direction = "down")

fit_training_datasets_metadata_clean %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "FIT", "fit_training_datasets_metadata_clean.rds"))
  
#Get datasets with blood-derived samples only, in both organisms
fit_training_datasets_blood = fit_training_datasets_metadata_clean %>% 
  filter(str_detect(human_tissue_control, "Blood"),
         str_detect(mouse_tissue_disease, "Blood"))

AllData_V2.0_blood = AllData_V2.0 %>% 
  filter(CSP_ID %in% c(fit_training_datasets_blood$comparison_id %>% unique())) 

AllData_V2.0_blood %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "FIT", "AllData_FIT_training_blood.rds"))

```

## Plot distributions
```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=20}
AllData_V2.0_distributions_plot = AllData_V2.0_manual %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(fc_hs:qval_mm),
               names_to = "metric",
               values_to = "value") %>% 
  mutate(organism = if_else(str_detect(metric, "mm"),"Mouse", "Human")) %>% 
  filter(metric %in% c("fc_hs", "fc_mm")) %>% 
  mutate(metric = if_else(str_detect(metric, "fc"), "fc", metric)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = value, fill = organism) +
  geom_histogram( position = position_identity(), alpha = 0.5, bins = 50) +
  #Facet
  facet_nested_wrap(vars(disease_group, disease_short, paste0(mouse_organ, ", ", human_organ)),
                    scales = "free_y",
                    # axes = "all",
                    strip = strip_nested(size = "variable")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01), n.breaks = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, 2)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(colors$organism))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c(colors$organism)) +
  geom_vline(linetype = 2, xintercept = 0) + 
    theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
        legend.position = "top",
        strip.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
        strip.text.y = element_text(color = "black", angle = 0, hjust = 0), 
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0, "lines"),
        strip.background.y = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
        ggh4x.facet.nestline = element_line(colour = "black", linetype = 1)) +
  labs(fill = "Organism",
       color = "Organism",
       x = "Log2-fold change",
       y = "Frequency",
       title = "All samples")
```

##Correlation plots
```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=10}
# Calculate the correlation

AllData_V2.0_manual_correlation = AllData_V2.0_manual %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  # filter(qval_hs <= 0.05 | qval_mm <= 0.05) %>%
  # filter(str_detect(human_tissue_control, "Blood"),
  #        str_detect(mouse_tissue_disease, "Blood")) %>% 
  mutate(
    csp_id_index = parse_number(csp_id)
  ) 

cor_data <- AllData_V2.0_manual_correlation %>% 
  group_by(disease, csp_id_index) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    test = list(
      cor.test(
        fc_mm,
        fc_hs,
        method = "spearman",
        use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
      )
    ),
    label_pos_x = max(fc_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    label_pos_y = max(fc_hs, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$estimate),
    p_value   = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$p.value),
    p_sig = case_when(
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    ),
    label_all = paste0("r = ", round(cor_value, 2),p_sig)
  )  %>%
  select(-test)


cor_data_degs <- AllData_V2.0_manual_correlation %>% 
  filter(qval_hs <= 0.05 & qval_mm <= 0.05) %>% 
  drop_na(fc_mm, fc_hs) %>% 
  group_by(disease, csp_id_index) %>%
  filter(n() >= 3) %>%      
  dplyr::summarise(
    test = list(
      cor.test(
        fc_mm,
        fc_hs,
        method = "spearman",
        use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
      )
    ),
    label_pos_x = max(fc_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    label_pos_y = max(fc_hs, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test, ~ as.numeric(.x$estimate)),
    p_value   = purrr::map_dbl(test, ~ .x$p.value),
    p_sig = case_when(
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    ),
    label_degs = paste0("r = ", round(cor_value, 2), " ", p_sig)
  ) %>%
  select(-test)



cor_data
cor_data_degs

AllData_V2.0_manual_cor = AllData_V2.0_manual_correlation %>% 
  full_join(cor_data %>% select(disease, csp_id_index, label_all),
             by = join_by("disease", "csp_id_index")) %>% 
  full_join(cor_data_degs %>% select(disease, csp_id_index, label_degs),
             by = join_by("disease", "csp_id_index")) 
```


```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=16}
#Log2FC scatterplot
blood_l2fc_scatterplot = AllData_V2.0_manual_cor %>%
  filter(human_tissue_disease == "Blood" & mouse_tissue_disease == "Blood") %>% 
  filter(qval_hs <= 0.05 | qval_mm <= 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    csp_id_index = parse_number(csp_id),
    comparison = paste("Comparison", csp_id_index)
  ) %>%

  #Plot
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = fc_mm,
      y = fc_hs) +
  
  facet_nested_wrap(~disease+paste("Comparison", csp_id_index, "\n All: ", label_all, "\n DEGs: ", label_degs), 
                    scales = "free", nest_line = T,
                    nrow = 4,
                    strip = strip_nested(size = "variable")) +
  
  #All DEGs
  geom_point(color = "gray90") +
  
  #DEGs in both organisms
  geom_point(color = "#4DBBD5FF",
             fill = "#4DBBD5FF",
             alpha = 1.5,
             size = 1,
             pch = 21,
             
             #Get only shared DEGs
             data = AllData_V2.0_manual_cor %>%
  filter(human_tissue_disease == "Blood" & mouse_tissue_disease == "Blood") %>% 
               filter(qval_hs <= 0.05 & qval_mm <= 0.05)
             ) +
  
  #Add linear models
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", geom = "line", color = "black", alpha = 0.5, se = F, size = 1) +
  
  #Add lines
  geom_abline(alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 1, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 1, linetype = 2) +
  
  #Theme
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size =8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0, "lines"),
        legend.direction = "horizontal") +
  labs(x = "Mouse L2FC",
       y = "Human L2FC",
       title= "Correlation plot, Log2-Fold Change")

blood_l2fc_scatterplot

#Save
blood_l2fc_scatterplot %>%
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", "FIT_TrainingData_blood_l2fc_scatterplot.png"),
         height = 10,
         width = 16)
```

# Predict with FIT
Ref: Normand, R., Du, W., Briller, M. et al. Found In Translation: a machine learning model for mouse-to-human inference. Nat Methods 15, 1067–1073 (2018). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-018-0214-9
Github: https://github.com/shenorrLabTRDF/FIT.mouse2man 

Load the FIT.mouse2man orthology mapping package from GitHub.
```{r}
# (Install orthology package if needed)
# library(devtools)
# devtools::install_github('shenorrLabTRDF/FIT.mouse2man')
library(FIT.mouse2man)
#Import files
pca_rotations = FIT.mouse2man::pca_rotations
best_models = FIT.mouse2man::best_models
HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez = FIT.mouse2man::HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez
MM_Entrez_symbol_desc = FIT.mouse2man::MM_Entrez_symbol_desc
Psoriasis_classifier_neg = FIT.mouse2man::Psoriasis_classifier_neg
slopes_per_gene_V2.0 = FIT.mouse2man::slopes_per_gene_V2.0
StaphInfection_classifier_pos = FIT.mouse2man::StaphInfection_classifier_pos
AllData_V2.0 = FIT.mouse2man::AllData_V2.0 #Training data
```

Obs.: Make sure that datasets from FIT package were retrieved

## Fluad
```{r}
#Import
all_degs_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "influenza_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) 

mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "processed_data", "influenza_mouse_exprs_hgnc_symbol.rds"))
### Loop for every time point -----
all_degs_fit2 = all_degs_mouse %>% 
  select(symbol, EffectSize = mean, condition) %>%
  inner_join(mouse_fluad_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% 
               select(symbol = human_symbol, MM.Entrez = mouse_entrez),
             by = "symbol") %>% 
  mutate(row = MM.Entrez)

# Generate csv for every condition
all_conditions <- unique(all_degs_fit2$condition)
purrr::walk(all_conditions, function(cond) {
  
  delete_dupes <- all_degs_fit2 %>%
    filter(condition == cond) %>%
    get_dupes(row) %>%
    pull(row)
  
  filtered_df <- all_degs_fit2 %>%
    filter(condition == cond, !row %in% delete_dupes) %>%
    select(-condition) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("row") %>% 
    select(MM.Entrez, EffectSize)
  
  file_name <- paste0(cond, "_FIT_mouse.csv")
  file_path <- here("tables", file_name)
  
# Save metadata to CSV
  write_csv(filtered_df, file_path)
})

# FIT loop
fit_results_combined <- map2_dfr(all_conditions, all_conditions, function(cond, cond_name) {
  
  file_path <- here("tables", paste0(cond, "_FIT_mouse.csv"))
  
  fit_output <- FIT.mouse2man::FIT(MouseFile = file_path, DataType = "rnaseq")

  fit_output_tbl <- as_tibble(fit_output) %>%
    mutate(condition = cond_name)
  
  return(fit_output_tbl)
})

#Print
fit_results_combined

#Save
fit_results_combined %>% saveRDS(here("tables", "FIT", "influenza_mouse_fit_prediction_alltimes.rds"))

# Load data
fit_results_combined = readRDS(here("tables", "FIT", "influenza_mouse_fit_prediction_alltimes.rds"))

#Pivot longer
fit_example_results = fit_results_combined %>% 
  clean_names() %>%  
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mouse_effect_size, fit_prediction),
               names_to = "measure", 
               values_to = "value") %>% 
  arrange(mouse_symbol) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = "Influenza",
         treatment = "Fluad",
         timepoint = str_remove(condition, "Fluad_") %>% str_remove("_PBMC")) %>% 
  select(pathogen,treatment,  timepoint, everything())

#Save
fit_example_results %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "FIT", "influenza_mouse_fit_prediction_results.rds"))

#Visualize distribution
fit_example_results %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = value,
      fill = timepoint,
      color = timepoint) +
  facet_wrap(~measure, ncol = 1) +
  geom_histogram() +
  theme_vaxgo() 
```



## Engerix B
Load the Engerix B mouse dataset from saved RDS files.

```{r}
# Load data
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "hepatitisb_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) 
all_degs_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "influenza_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) 
mouse_engerixb_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "hepatitisb_mouse_log2fc_sample_clean_long.rds"))
annot = readRDS(here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "probe_annot_hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse.rds"))

#Input
input2FIT = mouse_engerixb_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(annot %>% select(probe_id = agilent_sureprint_g3_ge_8x60k, 
                              MM.Entrez = entrezgene_id),
             by = "probe_id") %>% 
  select(participant_id, timepoint, MM.Entrez, EffectSize = log2fc) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, MM.Entrez) %>% 
  summarise(mean_log2fc = mean(EffectSize, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  mutate(row = MM.Entrez,
         pathogen = "Hepatitis B",
         condition = paste0(pathogen, "_D", timepoint)) %>% 
  select(row, condition, EffectSize = mean_log2fc, MM.Entrez) %>% 
  ungroup()

### Loop for every time point -----
# Generate csv for every condition
all_conditions <- unique(input2FIT$condition)
purrr::walk(all_conditions, function(cond) {
  
  delete_dupes <- input2FIT %>%
    filter(condition == cond) %>%
    get_dupes(row) %>%
    pull(row)
  
  filtered_df <- input2FIT %>%
    filter(condition == cond, !row %in% delete_dupes) %>%
    select(-condition) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("row") %>% 
    select(MM.Entrez, EffectSize)
  
  file_name <- paste0(cond, "_FIT_mouse.csv")
  file_path <- here("tables", file_name)
  
# Save metadata to CSV
  write_csv(filtered_df, file_path)
})

# FIT loop
fit_results_combined <- map2_dfr(all_conditions, all_conditions, function(cond, cond_name) {
  
  file_path <- here("tables", paste0(cond, "_FIT_mouse.csv"))
  
  fit_output <- FIT.mouse2man::FIT(MouseFile = file_path, DataType = "rnaseq")

  fit_output_tbl <- as_tibble(fit_output) %>%
    mutate(condition = cond_name)
  
  return(fit_output_tbl)
})

#Print
fit_results_combined

#Save
fit_results_combined %>% saveRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_mouse_fit_prediction_alltimes.rds"))

#Pivot longer
fit_engerixb_results = fit_results_combined %>% 
  clean_names() %>%  
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mouse_effect_size, fit_prediction),
               names_to = "measure", 
               values_to = "value") %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = "Hepatitis B",
         vaccine = "Engerix B", 
         treatment = vaccine,
         timepoint = str_remove(condition, "Hepatitis B_D")) %>% 
  select(pathogen,treatment,  timepoint, everything()) %>% 
  arrange(mouse_symbol) %>% 
  select(pathogen, timepoint, everything())

#Save
fit_engerixb_results %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_fit_prediction_results_alltimes.rds"))

#Visualize distribution
fit_engerixb_results %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = value,
      fill = timepoint,
      color = timepoint) +
  facet_wrap(~measure, ncol = 1) +
  geom_histogram() +
  theme_vaxgo() 

```









## S aureus

Calculate mean log2 fold-change values for each gene across samples.

```{r}
#Get log2fc mean
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "saureus_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) 

mouse_saureus_log2_hgnc_symbol = readRDS(here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "saureus_human_mouse_samples_log2fc.rds"))
annot = readRDS(here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "probe_annot_saureus_infection_mouse.rds"))

input2FIT = mouse_saureus_log2_hgnc_symbol %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
    filter(timepoint == 12) %>% 
  inner_join(annot %>% select(probe_id = affy_mouse430_2, MM.Entrez = entrezgene_id),
             by = "probe_id") %>% 
  select(participant_id, MM.Entrez, EffectSize = log2fc) %>% 
  group_by(MM.Entrez) %>% 
  summarise(mean_log2fc = mean(EffectSize, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  drop_na()
  

#Save
input2FIT %>% 
  write_csv(file = here("tables", "FIT", "saureus_mouse_fit_prediction_input_12h.csv"))

#Run FIT
FIT_day12_results = FIT.mouse2man::FIT(MouseFile = here("tables", "FIT", "saureus_mouse_fit_prediction_input_12h.csv"), DataType = "rnaseq")

#Pivot longer
fit_saureus_results = FIT_day12_results %>% 
  clean_names() %>%  
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mouse_effect_size, fit_prediction),
               names_to = "measure", 
               values_to = "value") %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = "Staphylococcus aureus",
         timepoint = "12") %>% 
  arrange(mouse_symbol) %>% 
  select(pathogen, timepoint, everything())

#Save
fit_saureus_results %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_mouse_fit_prediction_results_12h.rds"))

#Visualize distribution
fit_saureus_results %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = value,
      fill = timepoint,
      color = timepoint) +
  facet_wrap(~measure, ncol = 1) +
  geom_histogram() +
  theme_vaxgo() 

```
